title: Kirby Problem 3.20
exact_target: Does every faithful action of a closed hyperbolic three-manifold group on the line have a dual essential, transversely orientable lamination?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2818 (KP-3.20). CC BY 4.0.
